# Model import dependencies

Vendored unchanged from upstream, with their MIT licenses:

- [cgltf v1.15](https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf), `360db1a95480fe102ae9c69b27c5d101167ff5ba`.
- [tinyobjloader v2.0.0rc13](https://github.com/tinyobjloader/tinyobjloader), `2945a967c5303b2c8c14174117c45f3302591150`.
- [meshoptimizer v1.3](https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer), `9e1f07b159d3cb777f1c67ed31fc11fd117986f4`.

The model importer is static geometry only. These libraries do not execute content from imported files.
